title: Shopping list
shops: Sun 29 Nov (Mon 30 Nov to Sun 6 Dec), Sun 6 Dec (Mon 7 to Sun 13), Sun 13 Dec (Mon 14 to Wed 16)
estimate: Everything the meals need is on this list, in its aisle. An asterisk (*) means it might be at home, so check the house before you buy. Mon 30 Nov to Wed 2 Dec were shopped on 24 and 25 Nov. Meals are sized for 2 adults, with a couple of spoonfuls for the baby. Anything still unticked from the old lists 1 and 2 is at the end of each aisle.
